messages:
alex.h: Quick q — I'm seeing a brief SM% + mem spike on a subset of dedicated GPUs during a canary run. Where's the canonical Grafana panel for SM% / memory / KV cache hitrate? Also: which alert fired for smem and who owns it so I can loop them in?

mira.k: Panels live under infra -> gpu-fleet dashboard. Shortcut: https://grafana.internal.redwood/g/dGPU/fleet-smem-kv (panel id: 87 for SM%, 92 for KV hitrate).

mira.k: For traces, use the 'gpu-request-traces' dashboard or Jaeger link in the top-right of that grafana board.

jonathan.l: FYI the alert that usually trips is `gpu_smem_util_high` in prometheus rules (expr: sum by(pool)(avg_over_time(smem_util[5m])) > 0.92 for 3m). We decreased it to 0.90 for canary pools a few weeks ago, but dedicated pools still at 0.95 — confusing to track.

alex.h: ah ok — my canary was on pool=canary-phi. The spike correlates with batchsize=16 runs, KV cache evictions tick up right after.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: New canary run started by @alex.h — run id `canary-2026-03-18-11` · traces: https://tracing.internal.redwood/trace/canary-2026-03-18-11

jonathan.l: quick queries that helped me:
```
# smem util 5m avg by pool
sum by(pool) (avg_over_time(smem_util[5m]))
# kv cache eviction rate
sum by(pool) (rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))
```

sre-oncall: I'm oncall — pinged. I can take ownership of the alert for the next few hours. Suggestion: lower threshold to 0.90 for pools with label `tier="canary"` and add `for: 5m` to reduce noise from short spikes. Also add a secondary alert on kv_cache_evictions_rate > 0.5/sec per GPU for 2m.

sre-oncall: Example prometheus rule tweak I recommend:
```
- alert: GPU_Smem_High_Canary
  expr: sum by(pool) (avg_over_time(smem_util{tier="canary"}[5m])) > 0.90
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/gpu-alerts#smem
```

alex.h: perfect — can you also point me to the panel that shows batchsize distribution? I want to correlate request batch sizes with evictions.

mira.k: batchsize timeseries is on panel id 121 in the same dashboard (grafana link above). Query: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le,pool))` — shows p95 batch size per pool.

jonathan.l: small tip: when you inspect a spike open the trace, filter by `model=redwood-7B` and `batch_size` tag. That usually shows whether the KV cache miss pattern aligns with large batches.

alex.h: got it. I'll run the canary with batchsize=8 and 16 back-to-back and post screenshots. Thanks for the quick help :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: thanks — I'll patch the rule and leave a comment on the PR. If you see sustained evictions, tag me and add `incident` label so we can escalate. :eyes:
